capabilities: Insert code blocks with markup via commands
Trigger a markup selection menu with backticks
Rank markups by usage frequency with time decay
Define custom syntax highlighting languages and markups
Include Codeblock Customizer parameters in the markup list
extras: Can store usage records in a separate usage.json instead of data.json so sync tools can exclude them; credits the PrismJS library.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to quickly insert code blocks with the right syntax highlighting markup or to summon that choice with backticks.

relations.evidence: Optionally include the parameters of the Codeblock Customizer plugin in the markup list.

summary: Plugin that adds commands to insert fenced code blocks with a chosen markup and a backtick-triggered menu for picking the language.
